description: The drama is leaving your TV and coming to trivia night! From The Real Housewives and Vanderpump Rules to Southern Charm, Love Island, The Traitors, Survivor, and more, we're testing how well you remember reality TV's biggest feuds, iconic quotes, shocking betrayals, and unforgettable moments. Bring your team and see who's ready for The Reunion!
